senses.gloss: אִבֵּק, אִיבֵּק (denom. of foreg.) to cover with powder, esp. plants, for fertilizing.
units: M. Kat. 3ᵃ. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top.—Part. pass. מְאוּבָּק powdered.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:3:6">Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מאונקות</he> (read <he>מְאוּבָּ׳</he>) grapes fertilized with powder. [Ar. “to remove the dust”(?)]

senses.gloss: to be covered, or cover one’s self with dust.
units: Gen. R. s. 43.—Metaph. to sit at one’s feet as a disciple.
